title: Lwib
description: Simple and lightweight customizable inventory buttons.
body:
Lwib (Lightweight inventory buttons) is a clientsided mod that focuses solely on providing clickable and customizable buttons anywhere* in the players inventory.

A inventory button allows the user to send any command/chat message from the click of a button while inside any gui.

Customization includes any of the vanilla minecraft items as the button icon and the ability to change or remove the background color of the button. See [Gallery](https://modrinth.com/mod/lwib/gallery) for images.

*Anywhere means anywhere so it is up to the user to not place buttons in inconvenient places where it would overlap and cause priority issues with other mods/vanilla slots. Lwib by default takes the click priority of any slot so if you place a button ontop of a slot, that slot becomes unusable for regular use.

# How to use

Join any world/server and execute the command '/lwibedit' to start editing buttons.
